mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 48 degrees, though it feels like 39.

The City of Verona recently updated its zoning map and ordinance process, and residents are encouraged to check the city website to see their specific zoning district. Additionally, new polling locations have been established, so be sure to check the My Vote Wisconsin website before heading out to vote.

We have a busy weekend ahead, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, join us for Yoga at Insight Wellness this Sunday, followed by trivia nights starting next Monday.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior; fortunately, no injuries were reported.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy their flavor of the day, Chocolate Volcano, before they close at 10:30 PM.
